title: Research Evidence Navigator
purpose: Navigate contributor-scoped research evidence while preserving source provenance and the original evidence state.
allowedInputs: Knowledge Cards with explicit evidence state
allowedActions: draft Knowledge Card content without promoting evidence state
mustNot: promote SUPPORTED evidence to TESTED scientific or clinical evidence
store sensitive health data in public or on-chain evidence
limitations: Research navigation does not establish clinical validity, medical licensing or scientific certification.
Account-side publication and Contributor Passport linkage remain separate consent-controlled actions.
